call.signature_used: model.infer_multi(tokenizer, prompt=PROMPT, image_files=[PIL RGB pages in order], **fixed_kwargs, max_new_tokens=..., ngram_window=...)
call.prompt_expansion: native infer(): '<PAGE><image>' * n_pages + prompt (no <image> placeholder in PROMPT)

rules.max_new_tokens: 8000 * page_count (upstream tokens_per_page); the accepted min(8000 * page_count, max_length - prompt_len) equals this whenever prompt_len + 8000 * page_count <= max_length, which is verified from native prompt_token_ids after every call; otherwise CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (failed, never truncated)
rules.ngram_window: 1024 if page_count > 1 else 128 (upstream README evaluation setup), no whitelist
rules.eval_mode: explicit native default False: native TextStreamer stays on (stdout captured, bounded); unrelated to the eval() save path
rules.stop: native only: EOS -> finish_reason 'stop'; max_new_tokens or max_length -> 'length' (TRUNCATION failure); native PageCountGuard forces <PAGE>/EOS

sequence.expanded: cold load; W(F01) W(F07) [excluded]; R1(F01) R1(F07); R2(F01) R2(F07)

guards.basis: Harness policy, not measured performance. Phase timeouts bound the run; stall = no native model-forward return for stall_s inside a call (suspected WDDM paging stall). Revisit only through review, never mid-run.

storage.model_dir_rule: The model directory basename becomes the transformers_modules package name (upstream dynamic_module_utils local branch uses basename(path), per /003 phase A C10). It must be a Python identifier, so the coordinator-proposed leaf 'models\0480966…' (leading digit) is replaced by the identifier-safe 'Unlimited_OCR_2_04809669' (Astra /007 proposal); the revision pin is enforced by the 18-object digest check, not by the directory name. Passed as a normalized absolute path without trailing separator; never a repo ID.

free_space.basis: Astra /007 proposed stage gates: >= 58 GiB free before the first download, >= 20 GiB remaining at every stage boundary and during execution (supervisor polls and stops its child below the floor). The floor is a stop buffer, not a measured bound: pagefile growth and OS/driver allocations outside the root are unknown and additional (Q0R-05). Historical observations (69,064,572,928 B by Astra; 69,305,819,136 B by the coordinator) are not refreshed here.

observer.reconciliation: The /002 checkpoint's single command combining --query-gpu and --query-compute-apps was never validated and is replaced by two separate read-only queries, the forms already executed successfully in the Astra /001 host receipt (2c32dde:qualification/q0/preflight/host-receipt.json: gpu line incl. compute_cap 12.0; compute-apps rows with used_memory [N/A] under WDDM). The q0.py host-precheck command validates both against this host before any lease. Per-process VRAM is unsupported telemetry on WDDM; device memory.used is a whole-GPU observation that includes desktop/other processes (confounder, never a reason to stop another process).
